workbench.title: DEFEND & SMB Toolkit Verifier Workbench (53 Slides · 41 Capabilities · 51 Gates · 360p Guides · 4 pwsh7 Toolkits)

scenarios: Stage 1 & Phase 0 Discovery: 7-Dim Zero Trust Assessment + 7 Industry One-Pagers (14p, 30/60/90d motion, 8-Label Taxonomy)

decisions.question: How much of the 41-row Defender + Purview capability matrix does Business Premium cover alone vs with Suites?
decisions.selected_answer: Business Premium covers 15/41 (36.6%); adding Defender + Purview Suites reaches 41/41 (100.0%)
decisions.closest_label: Defender Suite upgrades 8/21 -> 21/21 security rows; Purview Suite upgrades 7/20 -> 20/20 compliance rows

decisions.question: How do Purview Tier 3 (Data Control) and the SOW Generator Priority 3 workstreams secure both Copilot and Shadow AI?
decisions.selected_answer: Dual AI Guardrail: DLP for Copilot (2-rule SIT+Label sim) + Edge Inline Web DLP (ChatGPT/Gemini) + DSPM
decisions.closest_label: Unlocks 12 Priority 3 workstreams in microsoft/SOWGenerator + 92-page Data Security Deployment Guide (pp. 42–90)

decisions.question: Can an MSP onboard a customer directly to DEFENDExtend (Sentinel SIEM/SOAR) before completing DEFENDComplete?
decisions.selected_answer: No — Slide 40 Governance Rule strictly prohibits activating DEFENDExtend without DEFENDComplete in place
decisions.closest_label: Ingesting un-tuned telemetry without Complete (42/51 checks) floods Sentinel with raw noise and alert fatigue

callouts.lead: Strategy + Execution Boundary: DEFEND (53 slides) + SMB Toolkit (6 aka.ms assets) are partner service accelerators, NOT Microsoft SKUs.
callouts.body: Capabilities require eligible licensing (Business Premium + Defender/Purview Suites + Sentinel), explicit configuration via the 360-page guides / PowerShell 7+ toolkits, and partner-validated commercial terms.

cards.eyebrow: SCENARIO: END-TO-END SMB TOOLKIT EXECUTION & AI READINESS (5 STAGES · 6 ASSETS)
cards.headline: From 7 Industry One-Pagers & 8-Label Taxonomy to 22 SOW Services & pwsh 7+ Automation.
cards.quote: No customer should progress between DEFEND tiers without meeting the exit criteria or formally accepting residual risk through documented governance. DEFENDExtend must not be activated unless DEFENDComplete controls are in place. — DEFEND Partner Playbook, Chapter 07 (Slide 40)

decisions.question: How do the 7 Industry One-Pagers & Data Security Assistant prevent sensitivity encryption from breaking LOB apps?
decisions.selected_answer: 8-Label DEFEND Taxonomy with explicit CONFIDENTIAL / HIGHLY CONF \ INTERNAL EXCEPTION sub-labels (5 & 8)
decisions.closest_label: Applies marking-only (no encryption, no external sharing) for ERP/EHR/SIS/MRP workflows with 90-day governance review

decisions.question: How do Appendix B (Slides 47–51) & SOW Generator Priority 3 prevent Copilot oversharing and Shadow AI leakage?
decisions.selected_answer: Tier 3 Data Control: DLP for Copilot (2-rule SIT+Label sim) + Edge Inline Web DLP (ChatGPT/Gemini) + DSPM
decisions.closest_label: Backed by the Day-30 DLP Simulation Exit Runbook before switching rules from simulation to active blocking

decisions.question: How does SMBBestPracticeTool (microsoft/BestPractice_Deploy-Scripts) enforce safe multi-tenant deployment?
decisions.selected_answer: PowerShell 7+ only, GDAP support, 13 Report-Only CA JSONs + break-glass check, Intune -IncludeHighRisk & ASR Audit
decisions.closest_label: Maps directly to the 6 Best Practice Deployment Guides (360 pages: Data 92p, Identity 90p, Email 52p, Device 51p/40p, SaaS 35p)

callouts.lead: Bridging M365 DEFEND + SMB Toolkit to Cloud-Native Agentic AI Security (Pillar 01 & Pillar 04).

callouts.lead: Why composite prerequisites (M01, M02, E01) cannot be bypassed via simple risk-acceptance waivers.

cards.headline: Operationalizing DEFEND + SMB Security Partner Toolkit for Copilot & AI Readiness
good_fit: M365 Business Premium MSP Catalogs: Standardize 5 outcome-based tiers (Base -> Extend) + 22 modular SOW workstreams
Pre-Copilot & Shadow AI Governance: Deploy Purview Tier 3 (DLP for Copilot 2-rule sim + Edge Inline Web DLP + DSPM) first
8-Label DEFEND Taxonomy with LOB Exception Sub-Labels: Use INTERNAL EXCEPTION (5 & 8) when encryption breaks ERP/EHR/SIS
Idempotent Multi-Tenant Automation: Use PowerShell 7+ SMBBestPracticeTool (13 Report-Only CA JSONs, GDAP, Day-30 DLP Exit Runbook)
not_for: Positioning DEFEND or the SMB Toolkit as official Microsoft SKUs (they are partner service frameworks; validate Product Terms)
Treating M365 Lighthouse as a SOC/SIEM replacement or device authority (Intune enforces devices; Sentinel/XDR handle SOC detection)
Activating DEFENDExtend (Microsoft Sentinel) before completing DEFENDComplete and tuning Defender/Purview alert noise
Running SMBBestPracticeTool on Windows PowerShell 5.1 or flipping CA/DLP policies to Block without Report-Only & Day-30 simulation
